exposure: Chlorhexidine cleansing of the umbilical cord
Application of harmful and nonharmful substances
outcome: Application of harmful substances to the umbilical cord
Predictors of newborns receiving chlorhexidine cleansing
cohort: Newborns born in Bangladesh and Nepal in the past year before the respective surveys (2017-2018 for Bangladesh, 2016 for Nepal)
finding: Coverage of chlorhexidine cleansing for newborn umbilical cord care was low, particularly in Bangladesh (15%), and delivery in a health facility was strongly associated with chlorhexidine use in both countries.
